title: Partner & Marketplace 1:1 Prep — AWS/GCP/Azure
content:
Quick scratchpad for my 1:1 with channel/marketplace managers (weekly cadence). Informal notes — action-oriented.

Meeting: Weekly sync w/ Marketplace PMs + partner leads
Date: 2025-11-05 (prep for 10:00 PT)
Attendees I expect: Maya (GCP), Liam (AWS), Henrik (Azure) — confirm offline

Primary goals
- unblock current private-offering submission (AWS) and confirm testing window
- align on telemetry / billing contract for dedicated customers routed via marketplace
- triage blocking legal/compliance asks for EMEA launch on Azure
- decide on rollout order + gating metrics (integration + e2e tests)

Agenda (compact)
1) Quick round — 2m each: current top blocker
2) AWS private-offering status (Maya to update) — verify manifests, billing mapping, AMI/SA permissions
3) GCP onboarding flows — marketplace listing + support contact card + telemetry tags
4) Azure marketplace compliance items — follow-up on IP/usage statements for legal
5) Cross-cloud rollout timeline and canary plan (who owns canary infra?)
6) Action review + owners + deadlines

Prep notes / facts to call out
- AWS private: pkg submitted 2025-10-28; portal shows "Pending validation"; legal asked for clarifying data-flow statement (see JIRA INF-2312). Need to confirm whether we can provide a self-hosted image or must use AMI.
- Billing: marketplace invoicing will be mapped to Redwood customer IDs — still need final mapping table (Liam owns). Current stub: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketplace-billing-mapping (ask Liam to share).
- Telemetry: we agreed to emit partner_source and listing_id tags in logs; need SRE to add sampling pipeline filter. Ticket: SRE-912 (awaiting triage).
- E2E tests: simple smoke + tokenized latency test + billing reconciliation test. Target pass rate 99% over 48h for canary.

Open questions / TODOs for meeting
- Can AWS accelerate validation if we provide a compliance attestation PDF? (Action: ask partner ops)
- Who is the contact on Azure legal for EMEA data residency statements? (Action: Henrik to share email)
- Do we want to gate GCP public listing on post-launch telemetry dashboards being available? (pros/cons)
- Confirm whether Dedicated customers discovered via marketplace should auto-provision dedicated pool vs manual ticket. (ops cost implications)

Draft action items (pre-meeting items I should push)
- Aisha: attach draft compliance attestation PDF to INF-2312 by EOD 2025-11-04.
- Liam: export billing mapping CSV + quick doc on invoice flow by 2025-11-06.
- Maya: status + expected validation ETA for AWS private offering (bring portal screenshot).
- Henrik: list Azure legal contact + any required template language for IP/usage by 2025-11-06.
- SRE (cc: Jonas): triage SRE-912 and estimate effort to add partner_source tag to logs (target: 2w).

Notes to self (scratchy)
- Keep the ask very concrete: "If we provide X, will validation be done in 3 business days?" Avoid open-ended asks.
- Bring example invoice mapping from Stripe -> Redwood internal account id (makes convo less theoretical).
- Remind partners of our canary safety net: automatic rollback to hosted API and quota-limited canary to avoid noisy incidents.

Follow-ups to record in GH / JIRA after meeting
- Create INF-XXXXX for compliance attestation final version (link it to INF-2312)
- Add billing mapping doc link to marketplace onboarding checklist in Confluence
- If SRE says >2w, escalate to Eng PM for prioritization

Potential risks to flag
- Marketplace validation delays push GA by 2+ weeks (impact: sales/commit deadlines)
- Billing mapping mismatch -> invoicing disputes for early customers (risk: revenue recognition headaches)
- Telemetry missing -> inability to properly attribute usage (ops + partner reporting problem)

Draft follow-up note I can paste to Slack / email after meeting:
"Thanks all — quick summary: agreed next steps: Aisha attach compliance attestation to INF-2312 by EOD, Liam to share billing mapping CSV by Thu, Maya to confirm AWS private ETA, Henrik to share Azure legal contact. SRE to triage log tags. I'll follow up with updated checklist in Confluence and assign follow-up JIRA tickets. Ping me if anything needs to move earlier."

Random scratch ideas (brain dump)
- Could offer a "marketplace-runbook" (short 1-pager) for sales to hand to customers: steps, timelines, who to contact. Might reduce back-and-forth.
- Explore whether co-marketing grant from cloud partners could offset listing fees for first 3 months for pilots. Ask GTM.

End of prep. Will tidy up post-call and convert to a cleaned confluence note & action list.

References (quick):
- INF-2312: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2312
- Marketplace checklist (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MP/marketplace-launch-checklist
- Billing mapping (stub): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketplace-billing-mapping
